metadata.tower_config: Each tower has 2 basements + Ground + 13 apartment floors. Apartment floor numbers in this file run from 0 (Ground) through 13.
extraction_notes: Unit number, floor range, type, facing, saleable area, RERA carpet area and balcony area were reconciled against the unit schedules in SALE UNIT 17-06-26.dwg.
Tower and floor configuration was cross-checked against 3.SITE & TOWER TENDER 04-05-26 - Copy.dwg.
Room dimensions were transcribed from the 46 PNG plans in public/New Floor Plans; repeated rooms are numbered in the panel-ready strings so no room is dropped.
Tower C Flats 03 and 04 share the same two images and the same schedule rows.
Tower D Flat 04 has no Ground+Even PNG, so its First+Odd image is the documented substitute.
The PNG named as Tower D Flat 01 Third+Odd is mapped to D-05 Third+Odd because the CAD unit schedule attached to that plan explicitly lists D-305 through D-1305 and identifies it as Tower D Flat 05.
Tower B Flat 01 has no separate First-floor PNG; its Ground image is used as the closest documented substitute for floor 1.
metadata.room_dimensions_source: Per-image transcription from all 46 PNG floor plans
metadata.room_dimensions_method: Read the metric and imperial labels printed on each plan image; obvious label/OCR inconsistencies were normalized so paired measurements agree.

area_extraction_summary.note: Tower C Flats 03 and 04 share schedule variants, so 48 schedule rows expand to 50 unit-to-plan mappings.
